reviews.title: It works so well it makes me mad
reviews.text: One Sec is the perfect app for someone who really want to cut down on doomscrolling. I use the free version of this app, and it’s still an extremely effective app. It does frustrate me sometimes when it blocks certain apps, but that just proves to me how addicted I was. reviews.title: Slow updates, morning journal broken with no way around
reviews.text: Horrible guardrailing against apple glitches. Morning journal will randomly appear throughout the day. The ‘reset screen time API’ switch is buried deep in the settings, making it unnecessarily difficult to find. It would make way too much sense to include a deep link to this or at least present the option when opening the app after an intervention. The recovery process is a nightmare, and app glitches become even more frustrating because of it. Fix this, and maybe it could be usable, but right now it’s painful.

reviews.title: IT WORKS SO WE
reviews.text: THIS APP HELPED ME SO MUCH!!! I went from scrolling from 9pm to 2am every night, to now regularly going weeks without using instagram. When you start on this app it feels really hard, I promise you, you are on baby mode. I remember HATING the 3 seconds I had to wait, and then immediately setting it to infinite scroll time. This app has helped me build tolerance to the level where I now have to wait 80 seconds before opening the app, and I can only use it for a max of 15 minutes at a time. I PROMISE ITS NOT AS BAD AS IT SOUNDS, after a while you get used to it. It means that using instagram when I am only spending a minute and a half on the toilet no longer makes sense. It's great! THE DEV TEAM IS SUPER GOOD AND RESPONSIVE TOO!! IF YOU NEED HELP EMAIL THEM, they are so nice and great :)

reviews.title: Used to be amazing
reviews.text:
I used to use the app about six months ago, and it worked perfectly. Now, every time I open the app, I’m forced to create a new account and sign in again, which is extremely frustrating.

On top of that, the app won’t let me block more than three apps at a time, even though I paid for a full year of the One Sec subscription. At this point, the subscription feels like a complete waste of money because I’m paying for features that either don’t work properly or that I can’t even use.

I really liked the app before, so it’s disappointing to see it become this difficult to use. I’d appreciate it if these issues could be fixed or if someone could explain why my paid subscription isn’t working as expected.

reviews.title: Amazing app to stop procrastination.
reviews.text: This app is great for people addicted to procrastination. It’s really eye opening to see how many times I opened this app and how much time I saved. Opening Instagram or tik tok has always been so impulsive to me that I don’t even realize it when I do it. This app provides a breathing exercise before opening up social media and it’s great to stop impulsivity and be more aware of the apps that you are opening up on your phone.

reviews.title: Privacy Concerns
reviews.text: I used this app for a year back in 2023 and then never used it again but it sat in my phone since then. I recently (as in July 2026) was saving a page on safari to my reading lists and one of the options was “Add to onesec’s reading list”. I am honestly baffled at why onesec would even have a reading list to begin with. It’s an app to lower screen time. I never created a reading list for this app nor did I give it permission to create one. Zero stars if I could.

reviews.title: Baited in

I also like that the app can set up with better alternatives. For example, when I try to open Instagram, after the waiting period, it suggests my learning apps.

reviews.title: Very limited free customizations
reviews.text: Overall, this app has helped me stay away from Instagram for some amount of time. What I’ve come to strongly dislike is the inability as a free user to turn off haptics for the breathing intervention. I get stressed by haptics and turn them off whenever possible, and I’m not in a condition to be able to afford or even need the pro version. For this reason, I’m considering deleting the app.

I’m more present with my family, have cut my overall screen time down exponentially. This app WORKS. My mental health has improved along with my relationship with my phone. And it keeps getting better!
